high_level_description: A Warrior-type MONSTER card artwork showing the following scene: a copper-haired academy girl rides a school desk across the courtyard while firing a bazooka larger than herself.

style_description.aesthetics: playful fantasy academy combat, exaggerated weapon scale, expressive young adult anime characters with consistent slender proportions and elaborate uniform silhouettes
style_description.lighting: clear directional daylight, broad colored shadow shapes, restrained highlights on skin and sharp highlights along metal edges
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, expressive hand-drawn anime anatomy, fine tapered linework, angular cel shading, selective painted transitions and richly painted backgrounds

compositional_deconstruction.background: A school desk skids diagonally over courtyard paving, throwing up short angular chips. Its legs bend backward under the load. A compact golden blast exits the left edge; the academy entrance and a crimson pennant remain clearly painted behind the action.

elements.desc: A young adult academy girl with pointed copper twin tails and a mischievous grin kneels securely on a sliding school desk, bracing both hands on her shoulder bazooka. She wears a navy sailor jacket, oversized ivory collar, crimson ribbon, gold star clasp, pleated skirt, opaque tights and reinforced boots.

An absurdly enormous crimson bazooka has a straight cylindrical launch tube longer than its wielder is tall and as thick as her torso. Broad ivory muzzle collars, stepped armor plates, a navy shoulder cradle, brass fasteners and a gold star crest define its heavy construction.
